author: han0110
content:
> Or do you think there’s value in being able to verify both real and mock with the mock verifier?
Yes, I think it'd be easier to configure in `ethereum-package`, so for example I only have 1 gpu I can have 1 mock prover and 1 gpu prover configured in `zkboost`, and in CL I only need to enable the mock verifier flag, then it'd be able to verify either mock proof or real proof. Just a naive thought, no strong opinion about how to enable the mock verifier in CL (can also enable through the proof engine json).

author: han0110
content: Updated and released `zkboost` to send `MockProof` ([def](https://github.com/eth-act/zkboost/blob/master/crates/types/src/execution_proof.rs#L41-L47)), and also updated https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/1492 to bring back mock zkvm backend, the `.github/tests/zkboost.yaml` should be runnable without gpu now.
